import sys, math, json, pathlib, time
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot

DT = 0.05
Q_DOWN = None

class Trajectory:
    def __init__(self, robot, start):
        self.r = robot
        self.p = np.array(start[7:10], dtype=float)
        self.q = np.array(start[10:14], dtype=float)
        self.records = []
    def to(self, xyz, speed=0.07, note='', cameras=('canvas_cam','practice_cam','side_cam'), video='none'):
        xyz = np.array(xyz, dtype=float)
        dist = float(np.linalg.norm(xyz-self.p))
        n = max(1, int(math.ceil(dist/(speed*DT))))
        ts = np.linspace(1.0/n, 1.0, n)
        poses = np.column_stack([self.p[None,:] + ts[:,None]*(xyz-self.p)[None,:], np.tile(self.q, (n,1))])
        res = self.r.submit('ee_pose', poses, dt=DT, cameras=cameras, video=video, note=note)
        self.records.append({'note':note,'n':n,'plan':res.meta.get('plan'),'clipped':res.meta.get('clipped')})
        self.p = xyz
        if res.done:
            raise RuntimeError('episode ended: '+repr(res.meta))
        return res
    def hold(self, seconds, note='', cameras=('canvas_cam','practice_cam','side_cam'), video='none'):
        n = max(1, round(seconds/DT))
        pose = np.r_[self.p,self.q]
        res = self.r.submit('ee_pose', np.tile(pose,(n,1)), dt=DT, cameras=cameras, video=video, note=note)
        self.records.append({'note':note,'n':n,'plan':res.meta.get('plan'),'clipped':res.meta.get('clipped')})
        if res.done:
            raise RuntimeError('episode ended: '+repr(res.meta))
        return res

def main():
    r = Robot()
    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=('canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'), video='none')
    now = np.asarray(obs.meta['proprio']['now'], dtype=float)
    T = Trajectory(r, now)
    q = T.q
    print('start tip',T.p,'q',q)
    # Ink the dry brush; the ink stone is at (-0.100, 0.150), surface z=.028 m.
    T.to((-0.100,0.150,0.075), speed=0.10, note='above ink stone')
    T.to((-0.100,0.150,0.017), speed=0.035, note='dip below ink surface')
    T.hold(1.0, note='soak hairs')
    T.to((-0.100,0.150,0.075), speed=0.05, note='raise from ink')
    # Two calibration lines on the unscored practice paper, with different pressure.
    T.to((-0.100,-0.220,0.075), speed=0.12, note='travel above practice sheet')
    T.to((-0.100,-0.220,0.018), speed=0.035, note='lower for shallow practice line')
    res = T.to((-0.100,-0.185,0.018), speed=0.035, note='practice line at 2 mm press', cameras=('practice_cam','side_cam'), video='mp4')
    pathlib.Path('/app/output').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    res.save('/app/output/practice_shallow')
    T.to((-0.100,-0.185,0.075), speed=0.05, note='lift after shallow practice line')
    T.to((-0.115,-0.220,0.075), speed=0.10, note='move to second practice line')
    T.to((-0.115,-0.220,0.014), speed=0.035, note='lower for deeper practice line')
    res = T.to((-0.115,-0.185,0.014), speed=0.035, note='practice line at 6 mm press', cameras=('practice_cam','side_cam'), video='mp4')
    res.save('/app/output/practice_deep')
    T.to((-0.115,-0.185,0.075), speed=0.05, note='lift after deeper practice line')
    # Reposition above the ink stone and reload; later character strokes are inked.
    T.to((-0.100,0.150,0.075), speed=0.12, note='return over ink stone')
    T.to((-0.100,0.150,0.017), speed=0.035, note='reload ink')
    T.hold(0.5, note='reload soak')
    T.to((-0.100,0.150,0.090), speed=0.05, note='raise clear of ink stone')
    final = r.get_obs(cameras=('canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'), video='none')
    final.save('/app/output/after_practice')
    pathlib.Path('/app/output/calibration.json').write_text(json.dumps({'records':T.records,'last_proprio':final.meta.get('proprio')},indent=2))
    print('calibration complete; tip',T.p)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""RoboPaint trajectory for the live rcb-limited/2.0 episode.

The practice calibration is recorded in calibration.json and practice_shallow/deep.
This script draws the four calligraphy strokes; --stage N runs only stroke N.
Pixel waypoints use target.png coordinates and are converted using the service's
main-sheet pixel/world mapping.
"""
import sys, math, json, pathlib, argparse
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot

DT = 0.05
MM_PER_PX = 0.22186
MAIN_CX, MAIN_CY = -0.100, 0.000
SHEET_Z = 0.020
PARK = (-0.100, 0.150, 0.090)
OUT = pathlib.Path('/app/output')

class Trajectory:
    def __init__(self, robot, proprio):
        self.r = robot
        self.p = np.asarray(proprio[7:10], dtype=float)
        self.q = np.asarray(proprio[10:14], dtype=float)
        self.records = []
    def move(self, xyz, speed=0.08, note='', cameras=('canvas_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'), video='none'):
        xyz = np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float)
        d = float(np.linalg.norm(xyz-self.p))
        n = max(1, int(math.ceil(d/(speed*DT))))
        f = np.arange(1,n+1,dtype=float)/n
        poses = np.column_stack((self.p[None,:]+f[:,None]*(xyz-self.p)[None,:], np.tile(self.q,(n,1))))
        res = self.r.submit('ee_pose', poses, dt=DT, cameras=cameras, video=video, note=note)
        self.p = xyz
        self._record(note,res)
        return res
    def follow(self, xyz_waypoints, speed=0.030, note='', cameras=('canvas_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'), video='mp4'):
        rows=[]
        prev=self.p.copy()
        for xyz in xyz_waypoints:
            xyz=np.asarray(xyz,dtype=float)
            d=float(np.linalg.norm(xyz-prev))
            n=max(1,int(math.ceil(d/(speed*DT))))
            f=np.arange(1,n+1,dtype=float)/n
            rows.extend(prev[None,:]+f[:,None]*(xyz-prev)[None,:])
            prev=xyz
        poses=np.column_stack((np.asarray(rows),np.tile(self.q,(len(rows),1))))
        res=self.r.submit('ee_pose',poses,dt=DT,cameras=cameras,video=video,video_fps=5,note=note)
        self.p=prev
        self._record(note,res)
        return res
    def _record(self,note,res):
        plan=res.meta.get('plan',[])
        fails=sum(int(x.get('ik_failures',0)) for x in plan if isinstance(x,dict)) if isinstance(plan,list) else None
        self.records.append({'note':note,'rows':len(plan) if isinstance(plan,list) else None,'ik_failures':fails,'clipped':res.meta.get('clipped'),'control_steps_chunk':res.meta.get('control_steps_chunk')})
        if res.done: raise RuntimeError('episode ended: '+repr(res.meta))

def pixel_xyz(u,v,z):
    # The exemplar spans 1024x1024 pixels on the 227.185 mm square main sheet.
    return np.array([MAIN_CX+0.227185/2-(v+0.5)*MM_PER_PX/1000,
                     MAIN_CY+0.227185/2-(u+0.5)*MM_PER_PX/1000,
                     z],dtype=float)

def make_strokes():
    # (u, v, tip_z). Deeper z spreads the soft hairs; the terminal rise tapers.
    pxstrokes = [
      [ # 1: left-falling stroke
        (401,250,.0170),(415,263,.0120),(425,300,.0115),(428,350,.0120),
        (430,400,.0130),(428,455,.0135),(422,505,.0135),(414,550,.0130),
        (400,600,.0125),(380,645,.0120),(355,685,.0115),(325,718,.0115),
        (294,743,.0120),(274,755,.0150),(268,760,.0190),
      ],
      [ # 2: top turn, long right side and returning hook
        (432,266,.0160),(465,264,.0160),(500,258,.0155),(535,251,.0150),
        (570,242,.0145),(589,240,.0140),(605,245,.0135),(619,260,.0130),
        (623,285,.0120),(623,350,.0125),(623,430,.0125),(624,510,.0125),
        (625,590,.0125),(627,650,.0120),(623,675,.0120),(611,688,.0120),
        (588,695,.0120),(560,696,.0130),(540,696,.0160),(555,712,.0130),
        (580,734,.0125),(601,754,.0130),(616,768,.0160),(619,772,.0180),
      ],
      [ # 3: upper interior horizontal, ending in a fine right tip
        (437,402,.0145),(462,401,.0145),(492,399,.0140),(520,395,.0135),
        (542,392,.0135),(558,394,.0145),(565,397,.0170),(567,400,.0190),
      ],
      [ # 4: lower interior horizontal, slightly rising toward its right tip
        (429,526,.0145),(465,523,.0145),(498,518,.0140),(525,512,.0135),
        (547,509,.0135),(560,510,.0145),(566,513,.0170),(568,516,.0190),
      ],
    ]
    return [[pixel_xyz(u,v,z) for u,v,z in s] for s in pxstrokes]

def draw_stage(stage):
    r=Robot()
    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=('canvas_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'),video='none')
    p=np.asarray(obs.meta['proprio']['now'],dtype=float)
    T=Trajectory(r,p)
    strokes=make_strokes()
    indices=range(4) if stage==0 else [stage-1]
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    for i in indices:
        pts=strokes[i]
        # Move above the intended first contact, lower there, then draw continuously.
        T.move((pts[0][0],pts[0][1],0.080),speed=0.10,note=f'stroke {i+1}: approach',video='none')
        T.move(pts[0],speed=0.035,note=f'stroke {i+1}: contact',video='none')
        result=T.follow(pts[1:],speed=0.030,note=f'main character stroke {i+1}',video='mp4')
        result.save(str(OUT/f'stroke_{i+1}'))
        # Lift straight off the paper before travelling to the parking point.
        T.move((T.p[0],T.p[1],0.080),speed=0.04,note=f'stroke {i+1}: lift',video='none')
        T.move(PARK,speed=0.10,note=f'stroke {i+1}: park',video='none')
        check=r.get_obs(cameras=('canvas_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'),video='none')
        check.save(str(OUT/f'after_stroke_{i+1}'))
        (OUT/f'stroke_{i+1}_meta.json').write_text(json.dumps({'records':T.records,'tip':T.p.tolist(),'proprio':check.meta.get('proprio')},indent=2))
        print(f'completed stroke {i+1}; tip={T.p.tolist()}')

if __name__=='__main__':
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('--stage',type=int,default=0,help='1..4 for one stroke; 0 for all')
    a=ap.parse_args()
    if a.stage not in (0,1,2,3,4): raise SystemExit('--stage must be 0..4')
    draw_stage(a.stage)
